scope: Pacific local progression only; does not by itself certify unrelated global-theater clocks
method_guards: old 96_SESSION_WORKING outcomes used only as sensitivity priors, not runtime authority
no historical script inheritance where geometry changed

guards: Technology is a dated dependency/card deck, not a scalar national tech level; foreign transfer fills missing cards only when prerequisites, artifacts/tacit knowledge, materials and absorption time allow.
Apply date-specific maturity and availability gates; no later German hardware/data or later parametron maturity is back-ported into earlier battles.
Nominal equipment does not equal combat power: hull/airframe -> availability -> mission set -> mission effectiveness -> allocation.
Distinct causal-stage improvements may compound, but effects feeding the same intermediate state are integrated first to avoid double counting.
Passive ESM warning and bearing history may improve preparation without constituting target-quality radar contact; preserve EM warning -> preparation -> contact -> track -> weapon-quality ladder.
Type 2P/early Type 3A accelerates multi-source correlation and traffic/DF inference; it is not universal decryption and does not convert a single clue into certainty.
A-grade base electronics can support persistent plot/control, field service, staged readiness, ESM-cued reconnaissance and limited EMCON/RCM only where equipment trace and date gate support them.

Japanese Type 95 aerial torpedo at Feb 1944 retains approximately historical Mod-1 warhead scale; Branch improvement is primarily straight-running/depth/gyro/lot/fuze reliability unless a later warhead gate is proven.
Damage is resolved as state transitions and four-stage survival/recovery, not as automatic campaign-out survival or a single hitpoint multiplier.
Jet research is indigenous before I-29; late-1943 repeatable short self-sustaining bench runs are plausible, but durable flight-rated engines and later German hardware remain gated.
No local operational radar is invented without equipment/shipping trace; specifically, Eniwetok remains without local radar under the current trace.
technical_inheritance.runtime_rule: For each future event, expose and apply only relevant date-valid technical cards plus branch overrides. UNKNOWN in a mandatory technical domain blocks final event computation unless explicitly waived.

environment.moon: dark waning-crescent night, approximately 14% illuminated; directional visual-acquisition penalty only
environment.weather_assumption: ordinary broken trade cloud / intermittent local squall band; no invented storm and no perfect-clear omniscience

cue_chain.submarine_update: one intermittent bearing/speed update is obtained, but not continuous shadow; it narrows one part of the search corridor and arrives too late to vector the whole package
cue_chain.attack_time_position_uncertainty: roughly 60-100 nmi-class search problem centered after TF58 night displacement and zig-zag

US_defense.screen: fast battleships/cruisers remain concentrated with carrier groups; destroyer radar pickets and maneuver deepen the defensive layers
US_defense.effect: radar warning is generally obtained before the Japanese package reaches carrier-core visual range, but night interception remains imperfect

result.sensitivity_only: one escort can receive a near-miss/splinter event; a torpedo hit remains a low-probability upper branch and is not canonical
result.interpretation: the stale sector cue creates a real attack opportunity, but darkness, search-area growth, US radar direction, maneuver and dense screening prevent reliable conversion
